answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded escrow: verifiable equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers correlated penalties scaling as O(k^2), rather than k independent fees. On detection, capital depreciation compounds, giving a swarm’s loss an exponential multiplier as exposed bonds are progressively haircut. Splitting one validator among aliases therefore increases, rather than diversifies, risk: an orchard of identities yields no nectar when a thread of shared evidence exposes the scheme.
